pairing.available_in_synchronized_tree: S-/V- filename pairs for the audited train/validation trips
pairing.metadata_file: none in the local synchronized source tree
pairing.duplicate_tree_copies: categorized and uncategorized copies exist; prior checks found audited duplicate vehicle files byte-identical
pairing.prepare_io_vnbd_files: scripts/prepare_io_vnbd.py discovers S-/V- files recursively, truncates to min length, pairs by row index, then sorts/deduplicates phone elapsed time and resamples

official_evidence.claim: The paper states simultaneously collected S/V pairs were manually synchronized where possible and stored in the synchronized folder.
The paper documents the phone holder, intended axis alignment, nominal 10 Hz acquisition, and vehicle CAN/VBOX fields.
No author-published numeric synchronization map, dropped-row correspondence, fixed rotation matrix, or reproducible preprocessing algorithm was found in the official repository/paper materials.

minimum_author_authority_package: per-pair synchronization event/offset and drift or sample-index correspondence
numeric phone-to-vehicle rotation and sign convention per recording
target/reference provenance and any applied filtering/resampling

new_recording_protocol.phone: raw accelerometer, gravity, gyroscope, magnetometer at >=100 Hz preferred; retain Android event timestamps and wall-clock timestamps
new_recording_protocol.reference: vehicle CAN/VBOX longitudinal/lateral acceleration and yaw rate at >=100 Hz or shared hardware-clock IMU
new_recording_protocol.speed: wheel-speed or VBOX/GNSS velocity with documented provenance
new_recording_protocol.sync: shared hardware trigger or visible/acoustic synchronization pulse recorded by both systems at start and end; retain trigger timestamps
new_recording_protocol.mount: rigid holder; record phone pose relative to vehicle axes with a measured calibration fixture

corpus_schema: raw_source: immutable original files and hashes
synchronized: common monotonic clock plus correspondence/quality flags
calibrated: vehicle-frame six channels plus persisted rotation/provenance
labels: indicated speed with provenance and independent references
splits: complete recording group separation; locked benchmark immutable

repository_history.official_repository: 4 commits shown; no releases/tags or synchronization/calibration implementation identified
repository_history.local_history: Percorsa history contains local adapters/preparation scripts, not the authors' missing metadata; no evidence changes the official-source conclusion

recommendation: Contacting the authors is worthwhile, specifically requesting the minimum authority package. Engineering should next create a separate Percorsa synchronized pilot recording with hardware/visible start-end triggers and measured phone pose; do not regenerate IO-VNBD or train until that provenance path is validated.
